fasta.title: Reference FASTA
fasta.errorMessage: Must be an uncompressed FASTA file (.fa, .fasta or .fna)
fasta.description: Reference genome FASTA used to build the STAR index. Must be uncompressed: STAR cannot read a gzipped FASTA.

gtf.title: GTF Annotation
gtf.errorMessage: Must be a GTF file (.gtf or .gtf.gz)
gtf.description: Gene annotation GTF for building a splice-aware STAR index.

star_version.title: STAR Version
star_version.description: Select the specific version of STAR to use (see quay.io/biocontainers/star for available versions)

star_extra_args.title: Extra Arguments
star_extra_args.description: Additional arguments to pass to STAR --runMode genomeGenerate.
